title: Xanthe and the Static
author: Rafael Thornbury
blurb: Ada Voss, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
